````r
  xs <- seq(0.12, 1.08, length.out = 201)
  rect(xs, -0.24 + yb, xs + diff(xs)[1], -0.19 + yb, col = DIV, border = NA)
  lab <- formatC(vmax, format = "g", digits = 2)
  text(c(0.12, 0.60, 1.08), -0.16 + yb, c(paste0("-", lab), "0", paste0("+", lab)),
       cex = 0.72)
}

## --------------------------------------------------------------------- UI
## an icon-only playback button; the title shows as a tooltip
ctrl_btn <- function(id, icon_name, title, class = "btn-default")
  actionButton(id, NULL, icon = icon(icon_name), title = title, class = class,
               style = "flex: 1; padding: 6px 0;")

row_label <- function(txt)
  column(1, div(style = "padding-top: 28px;", tags$b(txt)))

## learning rates on a roughly logarithmic grid (rates need to range over orders of magnitude)
LRGRID <- c(1e-5, 3e-5, 1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1)
LRCHOICES <- setNames(as.character(LRGRID), format(LRGRID, scientific = FALSE, drop0trailing = TRUE))

## one optimizer: its menu, then the parameters that belong to the chosen method
opt_row <- function(s, selected, col, none = FALSE) {
  a <- paste0("input.alg", s)
  has_lr <- paste0("['gdfix', 'sgdls', 'sgdls2', 'mom', 'adam'].indexOf(", a, ") >= 0")
  has_b  <- paste0("['sgdls', 'sgdls2', 'mom', 'adam'].indexOf(", a, ") >= 0")
  fluidRow(
    column(1, div(style = paste0("padding-top: 28px; font-size: 20px; color: ", col, ";"),
                  tags$b(s))),
    column(3, selectInput(paste0("alg", s), "Optimizer",
                          choices = if (none) c("None" = "none", ALGS) else ALGS,
                          selected = selected, width = "100%")),
    column(8,
      conditionalPanel(has_lr,
        div(class = "steprule",
          div(selectInput(paste0("lr", s), "Learning rate (first step if line search)",
                          choices = LRCHOICES, selected = "0.3", width = "100%")),
          conditionalPanel(paste0(a, " == 'mom'"),
            div(sliderInput(paste0("mom", s), "Momentum", min = 0, max = 0.99,
                            value = 0.9, step = 0.01, width = "100%"))),
          conditionalPanel(has_b,
            div(selectInput(paste0("batch", s), "Mini-batch size",
                            choices = c("5" = 5, "10" = 10, "20" = 20, "50" = 50,
                                        "100" = 100, "all n (full batch)" = 1e6),
                            selected = 20, width = "100%"))))),
      conditionalPanel(paste0(a, " == 'lbfgs'"),
        div(class = "steprule",
          div(selectInput(paste0("mem", s), "Memory (pairs kept)",
                          choices = c(2, 5, 10, 20), selected = 10, width = "100%")),
          div(style = "padding-top: 28px;",
              helpText("The step length comes from a Wolfe line search.")))),
      conditionalPanel(paste0(has_lr, " == false && ", a, " != 'none' && ", a, " != 'lbfgs'"),
        div(style = "padding-top: 28px;",
            helpText("The step length comes from a Wolfe line search."))))
  )
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  ## the iteration slider is the only state: the browser moves it (play timer, buttons,
  ## dragging), and the server just reads input$kshow
  tags$head(tags$script(HTML("
    var ktimer = null, kdrag = false, kself = false, kuser = 0;
    function kcur() { return parseInt($('#kshow').val()); }
    function kslider() { return $('#kshow').data('ionRangeSlider'); }
    function kset(v) {
      var s = kslider(); if (!s) return;
      kself = true;
      s.update({from: Math.max(s.options.min, Math.min(s.options.max, v))});
      $('#kshow').trigger('change'); kself = false; }
    function kplay(on) {
      if (ktimer) { clearInterval(ktimer); ktimer = null; }
      $('#play i').removeClass('fa-play fa-pause').addClass(on ? 'fa-pause' : 'fa-play');
      if (!on) return;
      var s = kslider(); if (s && kcur() >= s.options.max) kset(0);
      ktimer = setInterval(function() {
        if (kdrag || Date.now() - kuser < 600) return;   // the user is on the slider
        var s = kslider();
        if (kcur() >= s.options.max) kplay(false); else kset(kcur() + 1);
      }, 300); }
    ['mousedown', 'touchstart', 'pointerdown'].forEach(function(ev) {
      document.addEventListener(ev, function(e) {
        if ($(e.target).closest('.shiny-input-container').find('#kshow').length) {
          kdrag = true; kuser = Date.now(); } }, true); });
    ['mouseup', 'touchend', 'pointerup'].forEach(function(ev) {
      document.addEventListener(ev, function() { kdrag = false; kuser = Date.now(); }, true); });
    $(document).on('change', '#kshow', function() { if (!kself) kuser = Date.now(); });
    $(document).on('click', '#play', function() { kplay(!ktimer); });
    $(document).on('click', '#step',  function() { kplay(false); kset(kcur() + 1); });
    $(document).on('click', '#back',  function() { kplay(false); kset(kcur() - 1); });
    $(document).on('click', '#first', function() { kplay(false); kset(0); });
    $(document).on('click', '#toend', function() { kplay(false); kset(kslider().options.max); });
    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('krun', function(m) {
      kplay(false);
      var s = kslider(); if (s) { s.update({max: m.max, from: 0}); $('#kshow').trigger('change'); }
      if (m.play) kplay(true); });
  "))),
  ## small text for the row of weight buttons
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    .wbar .btn { font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 10px; }
    .wbar label { font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .wbar .form-group { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .wbar .selectize-input, .wbar select { font-size: 12px; min-height: 26px;
                                           padding: 3px 8px; }
    .steprule { display: flex; gap: 14px; }
    .steprule > div { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }"))),
  ## ---- control panel, at the top -------------------------------------------
  wellPanel(
    ## the data
    fluidRow(
      row_label("Setup"),
      column(2, sliderInput("n", "Sample size n", min = 50, max = 2000,
                            value = 150, step = 50, width = "100%")),
      column(1, selectInput("sigma", "Noise SD", choices = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1),
                            selected = 0.3, width = "100%")),
      column(1, selectInput("xscale", "Scale of x", choices = c("0.1" = 0.1, "1" = 1, "10" = 10, "100" = 100),
                            selected = 1, width = "100%")),
      column(1, numericInput("J", "Hidden units", value = 4, min = 4, max = 2000, step = 1,
                             width = "100%")),
      column(2, selectInput("lam", "L1 penalty \u03bb on the weights",
                            choices = c("0 (none)" = 0, "1e-5" = 1e-5, "1e-4" = 1e-4,
                                        "1e-3" = 1e-3, "0.01" = 0.01, "0.1" = 0.1),
                            selected = 0, width = "100%")),
      column(2, div(style = "padding-top: 25px;",
                    actionButton("newdata", "Regenerate data",
                                 class = "btn-warning", style = "width:100%;")))
    ),
    hr(style = "margin: 4px 0 8px;"),
    ## two optimizers, each with its own settings: A (green) and B (blue)
    opt_row("A", "adam", "#2E8B57"),
    opt_row("B", "gd", "#1F5FBF", none = TRUE),
    hr(style = "margin: 4px 0 8px;"),
    ## how long to run them, the colour scale, the play buttons, the iteration shown
    fluidRow(
      row_label("Run"),
      column(1, selectInput("maxit", "Max iterations",
                            choices = c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000),
                            selected = 100, width = "100%")),
      column(1, selectInput("ctr", "Contrast",
                            choices = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), selected = 8,
                            width = "100%")),
      column(1, selectInput("gtol", "Stop: ||g|| <",
                            choices = c("0.1" = 0.1, "0.01" = 0.01, "1e-3" = 0.001,
                                        "1e-4" = 1e-4, "1e-6" = 1e-6, "1e-8" = 1e-8,
                                        "never" = 0),
                            selected = 1e-6, width = "100%")),
      column(1, selectInput("stall", "Stop if flat for",
                            choices = c("never" = Inf, "100 its" = 100, "50 its" = 50, "20 its" = 20),
                            selected = Inf, width = "100%")),
      column(3, div(style = "display: flex; gap: 4px; padding-top: 22px;",
                    ctrl_btn("first", "backward-fast", "Back to the start"),
                    ctrl_btn("back",  "backward-step", "One iteration back"),
                    ctrl_btn("play",  "play",          "Play / pause",
                             class = "btn-primary"),
                    ctrl_btn("step",  "forward-step",  "One iteration forward"),
                    ctrl_btn("toend", "forward-fast",  "To the end")),
             checkboxInput("autoplay", "Autoplay on change", FALSE)),
      column(3, sliderInput("kshow", "Iteration shown", min = 0, max = 100,
                            value = 0, step = 1, width = "100%"))
    )
  ),  fluidRow(
    ## ---- left: the network of values above the network of gradients -----
    column(6,
      div(class = "wbar",
          style = "display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 4px;",
          actionButton("settrue", "True Value", class = "btn-success"),
          actionButton("newstart", "Random"),
          actionButton("setzero", "Zero"),
          div(style = "width: 110px; margin-left: 6px;",
              selectInput("astep", "Adjust Size",
                          choices = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1),
                          selected = 0.25, width = "100%")),
          div(style = "width: 90px; margin-left: 6px;",
              selectInput("netsel", "Network of", choices = c("A", "B"), width = "100%"))),
      plotOutput("netv", height = "520px", click = "netv_click"),
      helpText("Click the up / down arrows beside a weight to change the ",
               "starting value (this restarts the run). The true values are ",
               "those that generated the data. With more than four hidden units, ",
               "only units 1 to 4 and their weights are drawn; the vertical dots ",
               "below unit 4 stand for the other units, whose weights are fitted ",
               "in the same way but not shown (their colours count in the scale).")),
    ## ---- right: the fitted mean, and how the optimizer is doing -----------
    column(6,
      checkboxInput("showparts", "Show the units behind the fit", FALSE),
      plotOutput("fit", height = "380px"),
      conditionalPanel("input.showparts", plotOutput("parts", height = "250px")),
      plotOutput("conv", height = "340px"),
      radioButtons("lscale", NULL, inline = TRUE,
                   choices = c("log10 loss" = "log", "log10 (loss - smallest reached)" = "exc",
                               "loss" = "lin")),
      htmlOutput("info"))
  )
)

## ----------------------------------------------------------------- server
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  dseed <- reactiveVal(1); rseed <- reactiveVal(1)
  theta0 <- reactiveVal(rand_start(1, 4))     # the starting weights
  ## the number of hidden units, read once typing has paused
  Jr <- debounce(reactive({
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(input$J))
    if (length(v) != 1 || is.na(v)) 4L else max(4L, min(2000L, v))
  }), 800)
  ## a new number of units starts again from random weights of that size
  observeEvent(Jr(), {
    th <- rand_start(rseed(), Jr()); J <- Jr(); th[1:J] <- th[1:J] / xsc(); theta0(th)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  lam <- reactive(if (is.null(input$lam)) 0 else as.numeric(input$lam))

  observeEvent(input$newdata, dseed(dseed() + 1))
  ## a sensible starting learning rate for each fixed-rate method
  ## a sensible learning rate for the method and the scale of x: the curvature in a slope
  ## weight grows like s^2, and Adam's step is measured in the weight, which shrinks like 1 / s.
  ## The output adds up J units, so its curvature in the output weights grows like J, and an
  ## Adam step of about lr in every weight moves the output by up to about J lr: all three
  ## fixed rates are also multiplied by 4 / J
  for (s in c("A", "B")) local({
    s <- s
    observeEvent(list(input[[paste0("alg", s)]], input$xscale, Jr()), {
      a <- input[[paste0("alg", s)]]
      base <- c(gdfix = 0.3, sgdls = 0.3, sgdls2 = 0.3, mom = 0.03, adam = 0.1)[a]
      if (!is.null(a) && !is.na(base)) {
        v <- unname(base) / xsc()^(if (a == "adam") 1 else 2) *
          (if (a %in% c("sgdls", "sgdls2")) 1 else 4 / Jr())
        r <- LRGRID[which.min(abs(log(LRGRID) - log(v)))]
        updateSelectInput(session, paste0("lr", s), selected = as.character(r))
      }
    })
  })
  observeEvent(input$setzero, theta0(rep(0, 3 * Jr() + 1)))
  observeEvent(input$newstart, {
    rseed(rseed() + 1); J <- Jr()
    th <- rand_start(rseed(), J); th[1:J] <- th[1:J] / xsc()   # random weights for x / s
    theta0(th)
  })
  ## an arrow click moves the nearest arrow's weight by one step
  observeEvent(input$netv_click, {
    cl <- input$netv_click
    d <- ((cl$x - ARROWS$ax) / 0.05)^2 + ((cl$y - ARROWS$ay) / 0.04)^2
    i <- which.min(d)
    if (d[i] < 2) {
      th <- theta0(); j <- show_idx(nunits(th))[ARROWS$idx[i]]   # the slot's place in theta
      th[j] <- th[j] + ARROWS$dir[i] * as.numeric(input$astep)
      theta0(th)
    }
  })

  ## the predictor on a different scale: x -> s x, with the slope weights of the generating
  ## network divided by s, so the true curve is the same function of x / s
  xsc <- reactive(if (is.null(input$xscale)) 1 else as.numeric(input$xscale))
  TT <- reactive({ th <- TRUE_THETA; th[1:4] <- th[1:4] / xsc(); th })
  ## the true weights, with units 5 to J switched off (output weight 0)
  observeEvent(input$settrue, {
    J <- Jr(); th <- embed_theta(TRUE_THETA, J); th[1:J] <- th[1:J] / xsc(); theta0(th)
  })
  ## a new scale of x keeps the starting curve: the slope weights change with it
  xprev <- reactiveVal(1)
  observeEvent(input$xscale, {
    th <- theta0(); J <- nunits(th)
    th[1:J] <- th[1:J] * xprev() / xsc(); xprev(xsc()); theta0(th)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  DAT <- reactive({
    D <- make_data(input$n, as.numeric(input$sigma), dseed())
    D$x <- D$x * xsc()
    D
  })
  ## a test sample from the same process, the same for both optimizers
  DTE <- reactive({
    D <- make_data(1000, as.numeric(input$sigma), dseed() + 5000)
    D$x <- D$x * xsc()
    D
  })
  ## the loss on the test sample at every iteration of a run
  ## (at most 100 iterations are evaluated, and the rest interpolated, to keep large
  ## networks quick)
  tcurve <- function(R) {
    Dt <- DTE()
    ks <- unique(round(seq(1, R$n, length.out = min(R$n, 100))))
    te <- apply(R$P[ks, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(th) loss_fun(th, Dt$x, Dt$y))
    if (length(ks) == R$n) te else approx(ks, te, xout = seq_len(R$n))$y
  }

  ## one run for each optimizer, from the same start on the same data
  ## its settings are read once they have been still for 0.4 s: a new number of units also
  ## resets the learning rate, which reaches the server a moment later, and a large network
  ## should not be fitted twice
  mkrun <- function(s) {
    pars <- debounce(reactive({
      a <- input[[paste0("alg", s)]]
      if (is.null(a) || a == "none") return(NULL)
      list(a = a, th0 = theta0(), D = DAT(), maxit = as.numeric(input$maxit),
           tol = if (is.null(input$gtol)) 1e-6 else as.numeric(input$gtol),
           patience = if (is.null(input$stall)) Inf else as.numeric(input$stall),
           lr = input[[paste0("lr", s)]], mom = input[[paste0("mom", s)]],
           m = input[[paste0("batch", s)]], mem = input[[paste0("mem", s)]], lam = lam())
    }), 400)
    reactive({
      S <- pars(); if (is.null(S)) return(NULL); a <- S$a
      fixed <- a %in% c("gdfix", "sgdls", "sgdls2", "mom", "adam")
      req(!fixed || !is.null(S$lr))
      run_alg(a, S$th0, S$D$x, S$D$y, S$maxit, tol = S$tol, patience = S$patience,
              lr  = if (fixed) as.numeric(S$lr) else NA,
              mom = if (a == "mom") S$mom else NA,
              m   = if (a %in% MINIBATCH) as.numeric(S$m) else NA,
              lmem = if (a == "lbfgs" && !is.null(S$mem)) as.numeric(S$mem) else 10,
              lam = S$lam)
    })
  }
  runA <- mkrun("A"); runB <- mkrun("B")
  ## the test loss along each run, computed once per run
  testA <- reactive(tcurve(runA()))
  testB <- reactive(if (is.null(runB())) NULL else tcurve(runB()))
  ## the network panels show the run chosen in "Network of"
  netsel <- reactive(if (identical(input$netsel, "B") && !is.null(runB())) "B" else "A")
  run <- reactive(if (netsel() == "B") runB() else runA())

  ## the browser owns the iteration (slider, play timer, buttons); a new run restarts it
  observeEvent(list(runA(), runB()), {
    nmax <- max(runA()$n, if (is.null(runB())) 0L else runB()$n)
    session$sendCustomMessage("krun", list(max = nmax - 1L,
                                           play = isTRUE(input$autoplay) && nmax > 1))
  })
  kraw <- reactive(as.integer(if (is.null(input$kshow)) 0L else input$kshow))
  kpos <- reactive(min(kraw(), run()$n - 1L))

  cur <- reactive({
    R <- run(); k <- min(kpos(), R$n - 1L) + 1L
    list(R = R, k = k, th = R$P[k, ])
  })

  ## the colour scale of a run, from (a sample of) all its weights along the path
  vmaxr <- reactive({
    a <- abs(run()$P); if (length(a) > 1e5) a <- a[sample.int(length(a), 1e5)]
    max(3, quantile(a, 0.95))
  })
  output$netv <- renderPlot({
    C <- cur(); R <- C$R
    vmax <- vmaxr()
    par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
    draw_net(C$th, vmax, as.numeric(input$ctr),
             sprintf("%s: weights, iteration %d   (loss %.4f)", netsel(), C$k - 1L, R$L[C$k]))
  })

  ## one clearly different colour per hidden unit
  PCOL <- c("#F28E00", "#1F5FBF", "black", "#00B5CC")

  output$fit <- renderPlot({
    RA <- runA(); RB <- runB(); R <- RA; D <- DAT(); kk <- kraw()
    xg <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 300) * xsc()
    par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 2.5, 1))
    plot(D$x, D$y, pch = 19, cex = 0.7, col = adjustcolor("#E8820C", 0.5),
         ylim = range(D$y, mu_fun(TT(), xg)),
         xlab = "x", ylab = expression(mu(x) ~ "and data y"),
         main = "fitted mean and the generated data")
    lines(xg, mu_fun(TT(), xg), col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(xg, mu_fun(R$P[1, ], xg), col = "grey60", lwd = 2)
    lines(xg, mu_fun(RA$P[min(kk, RA$n - 1L) + 1L, ], xg), col = "#2E8B57", lwd = 3)
    if (!is.null(RB))
      lines(xg, mu_fun(RB$P[min(kk, RB$n - 1L) + 1L, ], xg), col = "#1F5FBF", lwd = 2.5)
    leg <- data.frame(
      lab = c("true mean", "starting weights", paste("A:", alg_name(input$algA)), "data"),
      lwd = c(2, 2, 3, NA), lty = c(2, 1, 1, NA), pch = c(NA, NA, NA, 19),
      col = c("red", "grey60", "#2E8B57", adjustcolor("#E8820C", 0.7)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(RB))
      leg <- rbind(leg, data.frame(lab = paste("B:", alg_name(input$algB)), lwd = 2.5, lty = 1,
                                   pch = NA, col = "#1F5FBF", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.78, lwd = leg$lwd, lty = leg$lty,
           pch = leg$pch, col = leg$col, legend = leg$lab)
  })

  ## the scaled units, which add up to the fit on the same scale as the data
  output$parts <- renderPlot({
    C <- cur(); xg <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 300) * xsc()
    VH <- unit_terms(C$th, xg); J <- ncol(VH)
    ## the units not drawn in the network are added up into one curve
    if (J > JS) VH <- cbind(VH[, 1:JS], rowSums(VH[, -(1:JS), drop = FALSE]))
    fit <- mu_fun(C$th, xg)
    mu_true <- mu_fun(TT(), xg)
    par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 2.5, 1))
    matplot(xg, VH, type = "l", lty = 3, lwd = 2.5, col = c(PCOL, "grey50"),
            ylim = pmax(-8, pmin(8, range(VH, fit, mu_true))),
            xlab = "x", ylab = expression(mu(x)),
            main = "the scaled units v_j h_j add up to the fit (with v0)")
    abline(h = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey70")
    lines(xg, mu_true, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(xg, fit, col = "#2E8B57", lwd = 3)
    ul <- c(paste0("v", 1:JS, " h", 1:JS), if (J > JS) paste0("units ", JS + 1, "-", J, ", added"))
    legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.78, ncol = 2,
           lwd = c(rep(2.5, ncol(VH)), 3, 2), lty = c(rep(3, ncol(VH)), 1, 2),
           col = c(PCOL, if (J > JS) "grey50", "#2E8B57", "red"),
           legend = c(ul, "v0 + sum (fit)", "true"))
  })

  output$conv <- renderPlot({
    R <- runA(); RF <- runB(); kk <- kraw()
    TA <- testA(); TB <- testB()
    ## the loss on the scale chosen below: as is, its log10, or the log10 of its excess
    ## over the smallest value any curve reaches (so differences near the floor show)
    sc <- if (is.null(input$lscale)) "log" else input$lscale
    best <- min(c(R$L, RF$L, TA, TB), na.rm = TRUE)
    ls_fun <- function(v) switch(sc, lin = v, log = if (best > 0) log10(v) else log10(pmax(v - best, 1e-12)),
                                 exc = log10(pmax(v - best, 1e-12)))
    ls_lab <- switch(sc, lin = "loss",
                     log = if (best > 0) expression(log[10] ~ "loss") else expression(log[10] ~ "(loss - smallest reached)"),
                     exc = expression(log[10] ~ "(loss - smallest reached)"))
    xl <- c(0, max(R$n, if (is.null(RF)) 0 else RF$n) - 1)
    par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 2.5, 1))
    plot(0:(R$n - 1), ls_fun(R$L), type = "n", xlab = "iteration", ylab = ls_lab,
         xlim = xl, ylim = range(ls_fun(c(R$L, RF$L, TA, TB)), finite = TRUE),
         main = paste0("loss (half the mean squared error", if (lam() > 0) ", without the penalty",
                       "): training (solid) and test (dashed)"))
    if (sc != "exc") abline(h = ls_fun(0.5 * DAT()$sigma^2), lty = 2, col = "grey50")  # the noise floor
    lines(0:(R$n - 1), ls_fun(R$L), col = "#2E8B57", lwd = 2)
    lines(0:(R$n - 1), ls_fun(TA), col = "#2E8B57", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
    ka <- min(kk, R$n - 1L)
    points(ka, ls_fun(R$L[ka + 1L]), pch = 19, col = "#2E8B57", cex = 1.5)
    points(ka, ls_fun(TA[ka + 1L]), pch = 1, col = "#2E8B57", cex = 1.5, lwd = 2)
    if (!is.null(RF)) {
      lines(0:(RF$n - 1), ls_fun(RF$L), col = "#1F5FBF", lwd = 2)
      lines(0:(RF$n - 1), ls_fun(TB), col = "#1F5FBF", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
      kb <- min(kk, RF$n - 1L)
      points(kb, ls_fun(RF$L[kb + 1L]), pch = 19, col = "#1F5FBF", cex = 1.5)
      points(kb, ls_fun(TB[kb + 1L]), pch = 1, col = "#1F5FBF", cex = 1.5, lwd = 2)
    }
    legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.85, lwd = 2, lty = c(1, 2, if (!is.null(RF)) c(1, 2)),
           col = c("#2E8B57", "#2E8B57", if (!is.null(RF)) c("#1F5FBF", "#1F5FBF")),
           legend = c(paste("A:", alg_name(input$algA), "train"), "A: test",
                      if (!is.null(RF)) c(paste("B:", alg_name(input$algB), "train"), "B: test")))
  })

  output$info <- renderUI({
    D <- DAT(); kk <- kraw()
    line <- function(R, te, a, tag, col) {
      k <- min(kk, R$n - 1L) + 1L; al <- R$A[k]
      paste0("<b style='color:", col, "'>", tag, ": ", alg_name(a), "</b> &nbsp; <b>",
             if (a %in% MINIBATCH) "epoch" else "iteration", "</b> ", k - 1L, " of ", R$n - 1L,
             " &nbsp; <b>loss</b> ", formatC(R$L[k], digits = 5, format = "f"),
             if (lam() > 0) paste0(" &nbsp; <b>L1 penalty</b> ",
                                   formatC(R$F[k] - R$L[k], digits = 5, format = "f")) else "",
             " &nbsp; <b>test loss</b> ", formatC(te[k], digits = 5, format = "f"),
             " (lowest ", formatC(min(te), digits = 5, format = "f"), " at ",
             which.min(te) - 1L, ")",
             " &nbsp; <b>noise floor</b> ", formatC(0.5 * D$sigma^2, digits = 4, format = "f"),
             " &nbsp; <b>||gradient||</b> ", formatC(R$GN[k], digits = 3, format = "g"),
             if (is.finite(al)) paste0(" &nbsp; <b>",
                                       if (a %in% c("gdfix", "mom", "adam")) "learning rate"
                                       else "step length", "</b> ",
                                       formatC(al, digits = 3, format = "g")) else "",
             "<br><i>", R$note, "</i>")
    }
    HTML(paste(paste0("<b>p</b> = ", length(theta0()), " weights (", nunits(theta0()),
                      " hidden units)"),
               line(runA(), testA(), input$algA, "A", "#2E8B57"),
               if (!is.null(runB())) line(runB(), testB(), input$algB, "B", "#1F5FBF"),
               sep = "<br>"))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
````

This app accompanies *[Optimization for Maximum Likelihood Estimation](../compstat_book/chapters/unit05_MLE.html#sec-sgd-app)* in the book.
